The '''Giants' Den''' is a [[dungeons|dungeon]] located just south-west of the [[Giant Pit]], within a cave housing a variety of [[Giant (race)|giants]]. All of the giants can be killed with or without a [[Slayer task]]. Giants in the den have access to the [[Catacombs of Kourend]] drop table, including [[Dark totem|dark totem pieces]] and [[ancient shard]]s. The Catacombs' effect of restoring prayer points when bones are buried also applies within the Giants' Den. Despite this, the [[Fire giant|Fire Giants]] in the Giants' Den do not count towards a slayer task required to be completed within the [[Catacombs of Kourend]], assigned by [[Konar quo Maten]].

The [[Vine ladder (Catacombs of Kourend)#Vine|vine ladder]] near the [[skeletons]] inside the [[Catacombs of Kourend]] must first be used to travel to the Giants' Den to unlock the [[Strange passage (Giants' Den)|strange passage]]. After it is unlocked, it can be used to travel both ways.

A [[dwarf multicannon]] '''can''' be used in the den; however, it is only [[single-way combat]].

[[Random events]] do not spawn while you are inside the Giants' Den. If a random event has tried to spawn while a player is inside the den, it will spawn at the next 5-minute interval after leaving.

==Transportation==
{{Map|1420,3588|mtype=pin|align=left|caption=Giants' Den cave entrance|width=250|height=250}}
* [[Lovakengj Minecart Network]] to Shayzien West brings you right next to the dungeon
* [[Kourend Castle Teleport]] or [[Xeric's talisman]] teleport to [[Xeric's Heart]], enter the [[catacombs of Kourend]], run west to the skeletons and climb the [[Vine ladder (Catacombs of Kourend)#Vine|vine ladder]].
* [[Fairy ring]] {{fairycode|DJR}} and run south-west, by the coast. Just south of the dock, there is a cave.
* [[Kharedst's memoirs]] or [[Book of the Dead]] to 'History and Hearsay' [[Shayzien]] teleport, run south-west through the graveyard gate, then north-west.
